description: Resume Checker Tool - AI-powered resume analysis with TealHQ visual parity. Users select from saved resumes, get scored feedback across 15 categories.

userStories.title: Create ResumeAnalysis TypeScript types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need type definitions for the analysis response structure before implementing the API or UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/types/resume-analysis.ts
Define ResumeAnalysis interface with: overallScore (number 0-100), categories (AnalysisCategory[]), generatedAt (string ISO date)
Define AnalysisCategory interface with: name (string), score (number 0-100), status ('pass' | 'warning' | 'fail'), feedback (string), issues (AnalysisIssue[])
Define AnalysisIssue interface with: description (string), severity ('low' | 'medium' | 'high'), section (optional string for navigation), suggestion (string)
Export all types
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created src/types/resume-analysis.ts with all interfaces. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Define AI analysis prompt with 15 categories
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a well-structured prompt that analyzes resumes and returns structured JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildResumeAnalysisPrompt function to src/lib/ai/prompts.ts
Prompt accepts resume content (sections: summary, experience, education, skills, contact)

Prompt instructs AI to analyze 15 categories: Contact Info, Summary, Work Experience, Skills, Education, Formatting, ATS Compatibility, Keywords, Grammar, Action Verbs, Quantified Achievements, Length, Consistency, Professional Tone, Overall Score
Prompt instructs AI to return valid JSON matching ResumeAnalysis type
Each category must include score (0-100), status, feedback text, and specific issues with suggestions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added buildResumeAnalysisPrompt with 15 categories, weighted scoring. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Create resume analysis API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API endpoint that accepts a resumeId and returns AI analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/ai/analyze-resume/route.ts
POST endpoint accepts JSON body with resumeId (string)
Fetch resume from Supabase by ID using server client
Validate authenticated user owns the resume
Call Groq API with analysis prompt and resume content
Parse AI response as JSON and validate against ResumeAnalysis type
Return analysis JSON on success, appropriate error responses on failure
Handle errors: missing resumeId (400), not found (404), unauthorized (401), AI failure (500)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created /api/ai/analyze-resume with auth, ownership check, resume extraction, AI call, JSON parsing.

userStories.title: Create Resume Checker page with auth gate
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access the Resume Checker page, with a login prompt if not authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/tools/resume-checker/page.tsx (dedicated page, not dynamic route)
Check authentication using getServerSession from NextAuth
If not authenticated: render login CTA section with explanation and button linking to /[locale]/login?callbackUrl=/[locale]/tools/resume-checker
If authenticated: render placeholder for main UI (will be filled in subsequent stories)
Hero section with title 'Resume Checker' and subtitle explaining the tool
Use existing translations from tools namespace where available
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: unauthenticated users see login prompt
userStories.notes: Dedicated page with auth gate, callback URL in LoginForm, route conflict fixed, i18n translations.

userStories.title: Implement ResumeSelector component
userStories.description: As a logged-in user, I want to select one of my saved resumes to analyze.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/tools/resume-selector.tsx as client component
Fetch user's resumes from Supabase on mount
Display resumes as selectable cards showing: resume name, last modified date
Selected resume has visual highlight (border color change or background)
Empty state if no resumes: message + CTA button linking to dashboard to create resume
Props: onSelect callback with resume ID, selectedId for controlled selection
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: selector shows user's resumes correctly
userStories.notes: Client component with Supabase fetch, ResumeSummary type, auth check, ARIA accessibility.

userStories.title: Create ScoreGauge component for overall score
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my overall resume score displayed prominently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/tools/score-gauge.tsx
Display score as large number (0-100) with circular or semi-circular gauge visual
Color-coded: green for 80+, yellow/amber for 60-79, red for below 60
Animated fill on mount (CSS transition or simple animation)
Props: score (number), size (optional, default 'md')
Accessible: score readable by screen readers
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: gauge renders with different score values
userStories.notes: Circular SVG gauge with animated fill, color-coded thresholds, three sizes, accessible.

userStories.title: Create CategoryList component for analysis breakdown
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all analysis categories with their scores and status.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/tools/category-list.tsx
Display list of categories from ResumeAnalysis.categories
Each row shows: category name, score, status icon (checkmark/warning/x)
Status colors: green for pass, yellow for warning, red for fail
Props: categories (AnalysisCategory[]), onCategoryClick callback
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: category list renders with mock data
userStories.notes: Category list with name, score, status icons, color-coded, accessible, click handler.

userStories.title: Implement category expansion with issues
userStories.description: As a user, I want to expand a category to see detailed feedback and issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Update CategoryList to support expandable rows (accordion pattern)
Clicking a category row expands it, clicking again collapses
Only one category expanded at a time
Expanded view shows: feedback text, list of issues with severity icon and suggestion
Smooth expand/collapse animation (max-height transition or similar)
Issues show severity: high (red), medium (yellow), low (gray)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: expansion works smoothly
userStories.notes: Accordion pattern, feedback text, issues list with severity badges, smooth animation.

userStories.title: Create AnalysisResults container component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the complete analysis results in a cohesive panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/tools/analysis-results.tsx
Composes ScoreGauge and CategoryList components
Props: analysis (ResumeAnalysis | null), isLoading (boolean)
Empty state when analysis is null: instructional text to select resume and analyze
Loading state: skeleton or spinner while analyzing
Display 'Analyzed at: [date]' below score gauge
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: results panel shows correct states
userStories.notes: Composes ScoreGauge and CategoryList, handles loading/empty/data states.

userStories.title: Implement Analyze button and API integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click Analyze to run the AI analysis on my selected resume.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Analyze Resume' button to Resume Checker page
Button disabled when no resume is selected
On click: call /api/ai/analyze-resume with selected resumeId
Show loading state in button ('Analyzing...') and in results panel
On success: display results in AnalysisResults component
On error: show toast notification with error message
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: full flow from select to analyze to results
userStories.notes: ResumeCheckerClient with state management, API integration, toast notifications.

userStories.title: Add Show Me navigation links for issues
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click 'Show me' on an issue to navigate to that section in my resume.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Show me' button/link to issues that have a section property
Button only visible when issue.section is defined
Clicking navigates to /[locale]/dashboard/resumes/[resumeId]#[section]
Resume ID passed as prop to CategoryList
Section anchors: summary, experience, education, skills, contact
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: clicking Show me navigates to resume editor
userStories.notes: Show me links with section validation, navigation to resume editor with hash.

userStories.title: Assemble Resume Checker page two-column layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see resume selector and results side by side.
acceptanceCriteria: Update resume-checker page to render two-column layout below hero
Left column: ResumeSelector component
Right column: AnalysisResults component
Analyze button positioned between selector and results or in left column
State management: selectedResumeId, analysis, isLoading
Proper spacing and alignment matching TealHQ style
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: layout renders correctly with both columns
userStories.notes: Integrated ResumeCheckerClient into page, maintained hero and auth gate.

userStories.title: Add responsive design for mobile/tablet
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the Resume Checker to work well on smaller screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Single-column layout on mobile (< 768px): selector stacks above results
Two-column layout on tablet and desktop (>= 768px)
Touch-friendly tap targets (minimum 44px height for buttons and cards)
Score gauge scales down appropriately on mobile
Category expansion works with touch
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser at mobile viewport (375px) and tablet (768px)
userStories.notes: Single-column mobile, two-column tablet+, touch-friendly targets, responsive gauge.

userStories.title: Add i18n translations for Resume Checker
userStories.description: As a multilingual user, I want the Resume Checker UI in my language.
acceptanceCriteria: Add resumeChecker namespace/section to src/locales/en/tools.json
Include translations for: page title, subtitle, analyze button, loading text, empty states, category names, status labels, error messages
Add same translations to fr/tools.json, de/tools.json, it/tools.json
Update Resume Checker page and components to use translation keys
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: switching locale updates all Resume Checker text
userStories.notes: Full translations for en/fr/de/it, all components use translation props.

userStories.title: Store and retrieve analysis results from database
userStories.description: As a user, I want my analysis saved so I can view it later without re-running.
acceptanceCriteria: Check if resume_analyses table exists, if not document that migration is needed
After successful analysis: save to resume_analyses table (resume_id, user_id, analysis JSON, created_at)
On page load with selected resume: check for existing analysis
If recent analysis exists (< 24h): load and display it with 'Last analyzed' timestamp
Show 'Re-analyze' button to run fresh analysis
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Save to resume_analyses table, auto-load cached analysis, re-analyze button.
